mapper.select: SELECT FROM sch10_ipo WHERE sch10_company_id = 0 AND upper(CONCAT(sch10_item_nm, sch10_note, sch10_iss_corp_cd)) LIKE upper(#{p.searchText}) AND sch10_market_cd LIKE #{p.marketCode} AND ( ( #{p.dateType} = '1' AND sch10_demand_start_date >= #{p.startDate}::date AND sch10_demand_close_date <= #{p.closeDate}::date ) OR ( #{p.dateType} = '2' AND sch10_subscription_start_date >= #{p.startDate}::date AND sch10_subscription_close_date <= #{p.closeDate}::date ) OR ( #{p.dateType} = '3' AND sch10_div_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate}::date AND #{p.closeDate}::date ) OR ( #{p.dateType} = '4' AND sch10_pay_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate}::date AND #{p.closeDate}::date ) OR ( #{p.dateType} = '5' AND sch10_refund_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate}::date AND #{p.closeDate}::date ) OR ( #{p.dateType} = '6' AND sch10_list_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate}::date AND #{p.closeDate}::date ) ) ORDER BY sch10_demand_start_date DESC, sch10_ipo_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch10_ipo (sch10_ipo_id, sch10_company_id, sch10_market_cd, sch10_item_nm, sch10_iss_corp_cd, sch10_demand_start_date, sch10_demand_close_date, sch10_subscription_start_date, sch10_subscription_close_date, sch10_pay_date, sch10_list_date, sch10_price_bracket, sch10_price, sch10_note, sch10_cancel_yn) VALUES (#{ipoId}, #{companyId}, #{req.marketCode}, #{req.itemName}, #{req.issCorpCode}, #{req.demandStartDate}::date, #{req.demandCloseDate}::date, #{req.subscriptionStartDate}::date, #{req.subscriptionCloseDate}::date, #{req.payDate}::date, #{req.listDate}::date, #{req.priceBracket}, #{req.price}, #{req.note}, #{req.cancelYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE sch10_ipo SET sch10_market_cd = #{req.marketCode}, sch10_item_nm = #{req.itemName}, sch10_iss_corp_cd = #{req.issCorpCode}, sch10_demand_start_date = #{req.demandStartDate}::date, sch10_demand_close_date = #{req.demandCloseDate}::date, sch10_subscription_start_date = #{req.subscriptionStartDate}::date, sch10_subscription_close_date = #{req.subscriptionCloseDate}::date, sch10_pay_date = #{req.payDate}::date, sch10_list_date = #{req.listDate}::date, sch10_price_bracket = #{req.priceBracket}, sch10_price = #{req.price}, sch10_note = #{req.note}, sch10_cancel_yn = #{req.cancelYn} WHERE sch10_ipo_id = #{req.ipoId} AND sch10_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: WITH upsert AS ( UPDATE sch10_ipo SET sch10_demand_start_date = #{row.demandStartDate}, sch10_demand_close_date = #{row.demandCloseDate}, sch10_subscription_start_date = #{row.subscriptionStartDate}, sch10_subscription_close_date = #{row.subscriptionCloseDate}, sch10_pay_date = #{row.payDate}, sch10_list_date = #{row.listDate}, sch10_note = #{row.note}, sch10_price_bracket = #{row.priceBracket}, sch10_price = #{row.price}, sch10_iss_corp_cd = #{row.issCorpCode} WHERE sch10_market_cd = #{row.marketCode} AND UPPER(sch10_item_nm) = UPPER(#{row.itemName}) RETURNING * ) INSERT INTO sch10_ipo (sch10_ipo_id, sch10_item_nm, sch10_demand_start_date, sch10_demand_close_date, sch10_subscription_start_date, sch10_subscription_close_date, sch10_div_date, sch10_pay_date, sch10_refund_date, sch10_list_date, sch10_company_id, sch10_market_cd, sch10_note, sch10_cancel_yn, sch10_price_bracket, sch10_price, sch10_iss_corp_cd) SELECT #{row.ipoId}::numeric, #{row.itemName}::varchar, #{row.demandStartDate}::date, #{row.demandCloseDate}::date, #{row.subscriptionStartDate}::date, #{row.subscriptionCloseDate}::date, NULL::date, #{row.payDate}::date, NULL::date, #{row.listDate}::date, #{row.companyId}::numeric, #{row.marketCode}::varchar, #{row.note}::text, #{row.cancelYn}::varchar, #{row.priceBracket}::varchar, #{row.price}::numeric, #{row.issCorpCode}::varchar WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM upsert )
